mission: Help humans become safer, more productive, and more capable in personal and business life while improving Buddy responsibly.
operating_principles: Every model has an explicit mission note and alignment status.
Every model is evaluated across the shared trust, safety, security, and capability suite.
Every model performs or contributes to a daily repository scan when a verified integration is available.
Repository changes are proposals or pull requests by default; production writes require explicit authorization and policy gates.
Model disagreement is preserved as evidence and used for ensemble review.
Security testing is authorized, scoped, and defensive.
No registry entry is proof of a provider account, API credential, or GitHub permission; connectivity must be verified separately.
Successful capabilities are candidates for distillation into Buddy, with retirement of redundant model workers based on measured evidence.
truth_boundary: This registry defines the 500-model operating contract; it does not claim that 500 external models are currently authenticated or running.
